unit_of_observation: one fictional student living on one randomized residence floor
assignment_mechanism: within each of four campus sectors, exactly 6 of 12 residence floors are assigned to the sleep-support program
target_estimand: intention-to-treat effect of assigning a residence floor to offer the sleep-support program rather than usual information for the fictional enrolled cohort
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of sleep or attention. Assignment, not observed use, is randomized; the sleep diary is a secondary measure with post-assignment missingness.
causal_structure: campus_sector and baseline measurements precede floor assignment
floor assignment -> sleep-plan use and follow-up attention
floor assignment -> sleep-diary completion -> observed follow-up sleep
motivation affects program use, diary completion, and attention but is hidden from the analyst
students on a floor share a floor-level shock

structural_equations.assignment: exactly 6 of 12 floors selected without replacement within each sector
structural_equations.followup_attention_score: 31 + 0.52*baseline attention + 0.9*(baseline sleep-6.8) + 3.0*assignment + 1.2*motivation + 2.2*floor shock + sector shift + N(0,5.2^2)
structural_equations.followup_sleep_hours: baseline sleep + 0.35*assignment + 0.25*motivation + 0.12*floor shock + N(0,0.55^2), observed only when the diary is completed

missing_value_code: blank followup_sleep_hours means completed_sleep_diary=0; every other field and the primary outcome are complete

variables.name: residence_floor_id
variables.role: cluster identifier and unit of random assignment

variables.name: assigned_sleep_program
variables.role: randomized assignment and primary ITT intervention
variables.unit: 1 program offer on floor; 0 usual information

variables.name: completed_sleep_diary
variables.role: post-assignment indicator that secondary sleep follow-up is observed

variables.name: followup_sleep_hours
variables.role: secondary outcome subject to post-assignment missingness

site_or_time_variables: four fictional sectors; baseline, assignment, intervention period, and eight-week follow-up
